answer: Consider delayed unlock of stake. An operator may whisper a swarm of throwaway agents into the roll, each branded with the same umber badge to look established, yet every reward sits in escrow for many epochs. During that wait, peer attestations and grades accrue; a coordinated cluster is slashed before a single coin can be spent. Only after that probation does value mature, the way yarrow spends a season in the soil before it flowers, so buying identities cannot finance the next wave.
